title: Må abonnere
body: Hvorfor kan man ikke kjøpe en app lenger uten å måtte abonnere på helt latterlig dyre abonnementer lenger? Har du tre apper du bruker så koster de deg kanskje totalt 1800 kr i året å bruke. Helt LATTERLIG forretningsmodell av Apple. Denne her er svindyr. Styr unna. Ja dere må ha penger for utviklingen- men det er forskjell på å ta litt penger og stjele alt en eier og har.
author: kkanst

title: The best goal tracker app
body:
First of all: it comes in TRUE DARK MODE, whereas most apps are GREY mode. Thanks for that. 

Second: If you follow it through, you want to keep your strikes and not miss a day. 

Third: It is very flexible in terms of how you set up your habits/goals. 

Fourth: It syncs very well between your devices.

title: More issues with time
body:
Still issues with the app.
In addition to the issue of all notifications disappearing when clicking on one habit, so I have to go in and manually check what I was supposed to remember to do, most of the habits are now stuck on «Due» even though they have been marked as «Done», have fex 3/3 marked, and are correct in the habit page calendar. The ones I have marked as «Missed» don’t look different at all, it just says 0/2 and is stuck on «Due». So I can no longer see what I did and didn’t do and mark for sure.
Pointless.

author: LMH1000

title: Good concept, but too much nagging
body:
This app is really gorgeous, and it has all the features I'd want in such an app. 

My gripes about it is that:

- it is too tedious to log anything else than today (to much pushing and scrolling),

- not possible to have a general alert that you should do today's logging. I have all notifications coming at the same time, and that makes my phone go bananas with sound,

- each time you log anything, a modal dialog will pop up saying you have met your goal (independent of if you actually met your goal or not), with the possibility to share on Facebook and so on. I'm not on Facebook, but this modal dialog is not something I can tolerate in an app,

- I think it should be possible to log directly from the dashboard. If you track just 4 things, you'll push a lot of buttons to get through them all. 

If those items were given a second consideration, I'd definitely give it another chance.
